name: 101 Easy-Peasy Things to Do With Your Computer
summary: This full-colour activity book and CD-ROM package has been designed for children aged four and over. Onscreen activities include a cyberpet to design and play with, a movie-maker to create simple animations, and themed treasure hunts to create. Key Features include free clip art and clip sounds and print-and-play activities which include finger puppets, dressing up, mobiles and party kids, and links to suitable Internet sites.
